summary: Approximately 316 km² and about 553,214 people (2023), from Wikidata's Q233 (P2046, P1082). The English Wikipedia article "Malta", at revision 1376158978, opens: "Malta, officially the Republic of Malta, is an island country located in the central Mediterranean Sea. It consists of two main islands, Malta and Gozo, which are 80 km (50 mi) south of Italy, 284 km (176 mi) east of Tunisia, and 333 km (207 mi) north of Libya. The two official languages are Maltese and English; Maltese is recognised as the national language." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Entity 338 in the Gleditsch–Ward state list, as mapped by CShapes 2.0, a dataset of the borders and capitals of states and dependencies between 1886 and 2019. The dataset gives it 1 period of territorial validity, from 1964 to where the dataset stops, in 2019. Its last capital in the dataset is Valletta. The code is mapped onto more than one actor (data/imports/cshapes-actors.json); this record holds the periods from 1964-09-21. This record was written by the import from those fields and asserts nothing the dataset does not.
